title: List of fixed-length chunks
statement: Given a natural number $c$, a Boolean list $w$, and a natural number $N$, form the list of length $N$ whose entry at index $i$, for $0\le i<N$, is the length-$c$ segment of $w$ beginning at position $ic$ (or the available portion if fewer than $c$ elements remain).
